_about: The portrait library (GDD §16.2, Appendix A.3.5): generic townsfolk busts for generated residents and arrivals, six expressions each. Each entry is tagged with the look the paper-doll rig draws for the same person (shared/src/look.ts CardHumanLook), so the dialogue bust and the walking sprite agree. Ids are lib_<presentation><age>_<nnn>: 001–040 are masters; 041–120 are colour variants, two per master in master order (master nnn's variants are 039+2·nnn and 040+2·nnn, e.g. lib_f05_001 → lib_f05_041 and lib_f05_042). A variant names its master in `variant_of`: the same person, face, age, build, attire and pose, with only the hair and clothing colours changed (`recolour` lists the changes; its look differs from the master's only in hair, outfit, accessory and headwear colours). scripts/art/gen_portraits.py --library draws masters against the style key and each variant expression as a recolour of its master's same expression; scripts/art/export_portraits.py exports them like any resident. Add rows to grow the library (new masters and variants take the next free numbers); never reorder or rename an id (saves store it).
